data.long_meaning: The name Berriman is derived from the Old English words 'beor' meaning bright or famous and 'rige' meaning raven or dark one. This name was likely given to a child born during a time of conflict, signifying both the brightness of their spirit and the dark challenges they may face. The name Berriman carries the meaning “Bright raven” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Berriman usually hope their child will grow to embody bright raven and live with faith, good character and purpose.
